clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lakeshire Inn, Yorus Barleybrew awaits Alliance warriors bold enough to answer his challenge. Trainers across Alliance capitals send seasoned fighters from Stormwind toward the Redridge borderlands to meet the eccentric dwarf and face his test of arms.

Across Alliance capitals, warrior trainers watch fighters who have outgrown their first drills. When an apprentice proves their mettle around their twentieth season, trainers such as Kelv Sternhammer, Wu Shen, and Darnath Bladesinger pass along word of Yorus Barleybrew. The dwarf offers no standard military order. Instead, he has issued an open wager and a test of arms to any Alliance warrior bold enough to answer.

Yorus Barleybrew waits at the tavern in Lakeshire, on the front lines of Redridge's struggle against encroaching gnolls and Blackrock orcs. Those who find him meet a boastful dwarf with a hearty drink in hand, ready to judge any challenger who claims true fighting spirit. For warriors seeking to prove themselves beyond the capital's safe cobbled streets, his trial opens onto the harsher battles of the frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yorus Barleybrew has issued a challenge to all able warriors of the Alliance. He waits at the Lakeshire Inn, in Redridge, and pledges a grand reward to anyone able to pass his trial.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah! So you heard of my challenge, did you?
Well sit down and listen. Have a drink, and savor it... Because it might be your last.
